description: Call this first. Resolves the base/head SHAs, OPENS THE DISTILLATION RUN, and returns the `run_id` every later call needs, the numbered hunk index, and `consent_state` — so you learn whether this repo is opted in BEFORE you spend a document finding out. It does NOT return the diff text: read that with `read_diff`, which pages it. Anchors use these hunk ids and pin to head_sha.

repo.description: Absolute path of the repository to operate on. Required in multi-repo/container setups; defaults to REVIEW_ASSIST_REPO or cwd.

name: compute_diff
